title: Identity provider sign-in, conditional access and VPN policy export
source_system: Identity provider admin console (SYS-11)
what_it_shows: MFA required for email, the ERP, the cloud console and the employee VPN; passphrase policy; VPN lockout after 5 failed attempts; sign-in alerts sent to the IT Manager

title: HR roster and terminations report, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: HR and payroll system (SYS-15)
what_it_shows: 162 employees by department (64 production, 22 packaging, 18 warehouse and shipping, 12 maintenance and instrumentation, 10 quality and laboratory, 8 engineering and EHS, 10 sales and customer service, 18 general and administrative); 14 terminations in the period, each with a last working day

title: Help desk onboarding and termination tickets, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: IT help desk ticketing system

title: HR onboarding and termination checklist
source_system: HR files
what_it_shows: Background check at hire for every employee; termination steps cover the identity provider account, badge and keys; no step for DCS accounts or loading rack driver cards

title: DCS and batch management system user, role and security settings export
source_system: DCS server pair (SYS-01, SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Three privilege levels (operator, supervisor, engineer); one shared operator account per HMI; one shared engineering account; one integrator account with engineer rights; 2 active DCS accounts carry the names of people on the HR terminations report; account lockout off on operator HMIs; recipe release in the batch management system needs one approval, held by the Process Engineer

title: Loading rack driver card list and rack PLC record
source_system: Loading rack system (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: 1 active driver card carries the name of a person on the HR terminations report; the rack PLC has an address on the business network

title: ERP user and role report
source_system: ERP admin console (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Roles assigned by department; one user can post an inventory adjustment, including for hydrogen peroxide, without a second approval; ERP sign-in runs through the identity provider

title: Endpoint management and EDR console export
source_system: EDR and endpoint management console
what_it_shows: 118 office laptops and desktops enrolled, each with the EDR agent and monthly patching; the 16 OT workstations (HMIs, the EWS and historian clients) are not enrolled

title: OT documentation request response
source_system: Controls Engineer's files; DCS vendor project file
what_it_shows: The newest OT network diagram is from the 2019 CFATS Site Security Plan and does not show the historian's second network card or the integrator remote tool; the DCS vendor project file lists controllers only; the request for an OT asset inventory, configuration baseline, control system change log, OT contingency plan, restore test record, wireless survey and OT monitoring records returned none; DCS restore and change steps are not written down

title: IT/OT firewall configuration backup and historian network settings
source_system: IT/OT firewall management (SYS-06); historian server (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: The rule set includes 'any' rules for the integrator remote tool and the historian; firewall logging is set to errors only; no rule review record; the historian has one network interface on the business network and one on the control network

title: EWS and HMI installed software lists and workstation settings
source_system: OT workstations (SYS-13)
what_it_shows: A remote desktop tool for the DCS integrator is installed on the EWS and starts automatically, with one shared integrator login, no MFA, no session approval and no session recording; office utilities on the EWS; USB storage enabled on all HMIs; operator HMIs are set not to lock; the EWS and historian clients lock after 10 minutes; lockout after 5 failed logins on the EWS

title: DCS backup job log and backup locations
source_system: DCS server pair; EWS (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Nightly DCS configuration and recipe exports complete and are written to the EWS, with a copy on one USB drive kept in the control room; no offline or immutable copy; no restore job or restore test is recorded; no record that the SIS program copy was ever compared with the running logic

title: DCS event journal settings and sample
source_system: DCS server pair (SYS-01); SIS logic solver (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: The journal records operator actions, setpoint changes and alarm acknowledgments under the shared account names; about 90 days kept on the server pair with no copy elsewhere; the SIS records trips and program changes

title: OT patch records, DCS vendor lifecycle notice and 2027 upgrade scope draft
source_system: Maintenance system; DCS vendor support portal
what_it_shows: OT patches installed only at the October 2025 turnaround; the DCS is two major releases behind the vendor's current release and still vendor-supported; vendor security notices go to a former employee's mailbox; no record of KEV catalog review or of hash checks on vendor update media; the 2027 upgrade scope draft lists no security requirements; the upgrade is not in the 2026 capital plan

title: Physical security records: badge access list, camera list, guard contract and guard logbook
source_system: Badge access system and video recorder (SYS-14); EHS Manager's files
what_it_shows: Perimeter fence; badge readers on the gates, the control room and the server room; 42 networked cameras recorded on one video recorder; a day-shift gate guard under contract; the guard logbook records physical security events only

title: Cloud account inventory, IAM, network and logging export
source_system: Cloud provider console (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: Workloads: LIMS virtual machines, order interface service, historian replica and analytics store, AI-001 model service, file shares, backup vault and log workspace; 2 named administrators who also administer the backup vault; service accounts for the order interface, replication and AI-001, with write access for the analytics account on the historian replica; no public addresses; site-to-site IPsec VPN from the plant with network rules allowing the plant range only; storage encrypted at rest with provider-managed keys; log workspace collects cloud audit and identity sign-in logs with 90-day retention and no plant or OT sources; LIMS guest OS patched monthly; no written configuration baseline or posture checks

title: Cloud backup job reports, April to June 2026
source_system: Cloud backup service (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: Daily backups of the LIMS and file shares complete, with a copy in a second region; the vault sits in the production account; immutability setting off

title: File share permission export
source_system: Managed file service (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: The folder holding legacy CVI, the 2019 Site Security Plan and formulation files is open to 40 users; the shares are writable by all office users

title: Order interface design note and validation rules
source_system: IT documentation (SYS-10 order interface)
what_it_shows: The order interface sends order records (product code, quantity, due date) from the ERP to the batch management system through the IT/OT firewall; it rejects batch sizes outside the recipe limits

title: Policies folder and document request response
source_system: Company shared drive; document request list
what_it_shows: A 2019 policy template set with no OT content; no data classification policy, remote access standard or AI use rules; the IT incident response plan (2023) and the IT contingency plan cover office systems only

title: MOC procedure rev. 2021 and MOC log, January 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Process engineering files
what_it_shows: The procedure covers process chemistry and equipment; the log has no entries for DCS, SIS, PLC, recipe or firewall changes; no control system change history is kept

title: DCS configuration and alarm export with the 2019 hardening checklist
source_system: DCS engineering workstation (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: The vendor hardening checklist was completed at the 2019 install; the alarm export lists alarm limits and clamps for the ammonia process; no record of a comparison with the RMP safe operating limits

title: Security training records, 2025 to June 2026
source_system: HR learning records
what_it_shows: Annual security awareness training assigned to and completed by office staff; no security training assigned to operators, maintenance staff, the DCS integrator or other contractors; no phishing exercises recorded

title: Help desk security-related ticket history, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: IT help desk ticketing system
what_it_shows: Phishing reports and office endpoint alerts handled by the help desk; no tickets from the control room or OT systems

title: Organization chart, job descriptions and IT security designation memo
source_system: HR files
what_it_shows: The memo and job description give the IT Manager part-time security duties for office IT; the EHS Manager keeps physical security from the former facility security officer role; no document assigns OT security

title: Employee handbook
source_system: HR files
what_it_shows: General code of conduct and discipline section

title: Legacy CFATS records
source_system: EHS Manager's files; locked CVI cabinet
what_it_shows: CSAT Top-Screen filed in 2008 for 50% hydrogen peroxide; tier notice; approved Site Security Plan last revised in 2019, with a cyber section describing an IT/OT firewall, password rules and a backup practice; security vulnerability assessment; paper CVI kept in a locked cabinet in the EHS office

title: RMP registration, submission history and management system document
source_system: EPA RMP submission records; EHS Manager's files
what_it_shows: Program 2 registration for the aqueous ammonia process; five-year update submitted 2024-03-18 with the 2024 worst-case release analysis reaching public receptors; non-responding stationary source; no resubmission since; the management system document names the Plant Manager as qualified person and assigns no control system or SIS configuration duties

title: Process safety information binder
source_system: EHS Manager's files
what_it_shows: Safe upper and lower limits for the ammonia process; maximum intended inventories (29% aqueous ammonia tank level limit 11,000 gal; 50% hydrogen peroxide combined level limit 7,000 gal; 31.5% hydrochloric acid 10,000-gal tank; 93% sulfuric acid 6,000-gal tank; 12.5% sodium hypochlorite two 8,000-gal tanks; isopropyl alcohol cap of 4 totes); supplier SDS for each chemical; the site plan shows a rail siding and a truck loading rack and no marine transfer or dock

title: 2024 RMP hazard review report
source_system: EHS Manager's files
what_it_shows: Covers instrument failures and operator errors for the ammonia process; lists no scenario of deliberate or erroneous changes to DCS setpoints or logic; fixed ammonia detectors at the tank, the unloading station and Blend Hall A, alarmed in the control room and trip-linked to the SIS

title: 2025 RMP compliance audit report and response log
source_system: EHS Manager's files
what_it_shows: Audit completed 2025-06-12; the response log shows each audit finding closed

title: Emergency action plan rev. 2024 and emergency coordination records
source_system: EHS Manager's files
what_it_shows: Employees evacuate and county fire rescue responds; the call list covers 911, the sheriff, the National Response Center, the SERC and the LEPC, called by phone from the control room; no cyber incident reporting contacts; LEPC letter (2025) confirms the plant is in the county plan; coordination meeting with county fire rescue and the LEPC on 2025-10-09; notification exercise held 2025-11-06

title: Operating procedures, RMP training matrix and incident investigation procedure
source_system: EHS Manager's files; operating procedure manual
what_it_shows: Operating procedure manual rev. 2024 includes an emergency shutdown procedure and no procedure for operating when HMI displays cannot be trusted or the DCS is lost; the procedure revision log shows updates for equipment changes only; the RMP training matrix (June 2026) shows all 64 operators trained with refreshers current; the incident investigation procedure rev. 2022 has no step on control system tampering or on preserving DCS and SIS evidence

title: Maintenance records, October 2025 turnaround: SIS proof test, UPS tests and detector calibration
source_system: Maintenance system
what_it_shows: SIS proof test completed 2025-10-21, including loss of power and communication closing the ammonia remote isolation valve and tripping the transfer pumps; the proof test procedure has no step to return the keyswitch to run and verify it; SIS safety requirements specification and drawings on file; UPS on the DCS servers and controllers, the SIS, the gas detectors and the control room, tested at the turnaround; ammonia detector calibration records current

title: Phone system design and control room call list
source_system: IT documentation; control room
what_it_shows: Control room and gatehouse phones are VoIP phones on the business network; no cellular phones or radios are assigned for emergency notification

title: Accounts payable vendor list, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: ERP accounts payable (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Payments to 15 suppliers that touch systems or data: the ERP vendor, identity provider, productivity suite vendor, cloud provider, HR and payroll vendor, LIMS software vendor, DCS vendor (support contract), DCS integrator, data science contractor (AI-001 build), SIS vendor field service, security guard contractor, paper shredding vendor, internet provider, cellular carrier and the cyber insurer; one internet provider

title: Contracts folder: service, support and subscription agreements
source_system: Controller's contracts folder
what_it_shows: DCS integrator service agreement with a confidentiality clause and no terms on security, remote access, staff screening or incident notice; data science contractor agreement with no security clauses; ERP subscription agreement with confidentiality terms and no incident notice clause; HR and payroll vendor contract with no SOC 2 report on file; DCS vendor support contract

title: ERP vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: ERP vendor customer portal
what_it_shows: Type 2 report for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, with the system description (replication with a stated RPO of 1 hour and RTO of 8 hours) and complementary user entity controls; no record of an earlier review by the company

title: Cloud provider SOC 2 report and shared responsibility documentation
source_system: Cloud provider compliance portal
what_it_shows: Provider SOC 2 report covering its data centers and services in use, and the provider's published shared responsibility description, including control-plane audit logging

title: FY2025 revenue and customer sales report
source_system: ERP financial reporting (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Annual revenue of $74 million across 250 production days; about 600 active business customers; the largest private-label customer accounts for about 18% of revenue

title: Production and shipping volume report, Q2 2026
source_system: ERP and batch management system reports
what_it_shows: About 420 active formulations and 1,150 packaged SKUs; about 35 batches and 25 outbound truckloads a day; about 80% of volume blended in Blend Hall A

title: Customer supplier security questionnaire
source_system: Customer Service Manager's email
what_it_shows: The largest private-label customer asks how the company protects its private-label formulations and order data and how supply would continue after a cyber incident

title: Cyber insurance policy and claim instructions
source_system: Controller's insurance files
what_it_shows: A cyber insurance policy in force; claims start with the carrier breach hotline, and counsel and forensic firms are engaged through the carrier

title: AI tool review: accounts payable, identity provider app list, cloud console and staff survey
source_system: Accounts payable list; identity provider app list; cloud console; staff survey
what_it_shows: AI-001 process-optimization model in pilot on 2 Blend Hall A tanks since May 2026, built by the data science contractor on the cloud tenant's managed ML platform, with recommendations shown on a control room dashboard; no AI risk assessment or approved-tools list on file; staff report using public generative AI chatbots; an enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite is under evaluation by the IT Manager

title: Paper shredding certificates
source_system: Shredding vendor certificates
what_it_shows: Monthly certificates of destruction for office paper records

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Plant Manager, EHS Manager, Controls Engineer, Process Engineer, Quality Manager, Controller, HR Manager)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say the process can tolerate; spare DCS hardware is kept on site

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (Plant Manager, Controls Engineer, EHS Manager, Process Engineer, Controller)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past disruptions and near misses: hurricane shutdowns with no restart checklist for OT and no generator for the office; outages of the single internet provider; payment-change requests received by email with no callback step; informal screening of hydrogen peroxide orders; the Controls Engineer as the only person who can restore or change the DCS

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (IT Manager, Controls Engineer, 3 Shift Supervisors, DCS integrator lead engineer, EHS Manager, Process Engineer, HR Manager, Plant Manager)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each RBPS 8 measure and RMP element is carried out today. The Controls Engineer states that the loading rack PLC password was never changed from the manufacturer default, that HMI shared passwords have not changed since 2019, and that nobody reviews OT vulnerabilities. Shift Supervisors describe treating unexpected setpoint changes as instrument or operator issues, with no escalation path to IT. IT and Controls Engineering have no joint forum. The integrator connects through the remote tool whenever support is needed

title: Plant walkthrough
source_system: Control room, engineering office, server room, Blend Hall A, tank farm and EHS office (observation)
what_it_shows: Control room and server room badge-controlled; the control room is staffed and operator HMIs stay unlocked; the engineering office holding the EWS is not locked on night shift (Shift Supervisor account); USB drives in use at HMIs; paper CVI in a locked cabinet in the EHS office; DCS controllers and network switches in Blend Hall A, the control room and the tank farm

title: IT/OT firewall rule export and business network scan
source_system: IT/OT firewall management (SYS-06); network scanner run by the IT Manager
what_it_shows: Rule-by-rule export: 'any' rules for the integrator remote tool and the historian; the employee VPN address range is allowed to the DCS servers; logging set to errors only. The scan of the business network found the badge server and the video recorder on the flat business network

title: External TLS scan of the VPN and LIMS endpoints
source_system: Scanning tool run by the IT Manager
what_it_shows: The employee VPN and LIMS endpoints accept TLS 1.2 or later only

title: Plant wireless survey
source_system: Wireless survey run by the assessor with the Controls Engineer
what_it_shows: No wireless access point was detected on the control or supervisory networks in the control room, Blend Hall A or the tank farm

title: Productivity suite mail protection policy export
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-12)
what_it_shows: The vendor's spam and malicious attachment filtering is on, with the company's policy settings applied to all mailboxes

title: Control assessment: OT account management review
source_system: DCS user list export 2026-08-12; rack card list; termination tickets (sample of 6 of the 14); identity provider export; Controls Engineer and HR Manager interviews
what_it_shows: Identity provider accounts in the sample were disabled on the last working day; OT account types are not documented; shared HMI and engineering accounts in use; 2 DCS accounts and 1 rack card of departed staff active until disabled on 2026-08-14; no OT account review record

title: Control assessment: remote access review
source_system: EWS installed software list; firewall rule export; integrator agreement; Controls Engineer and integrator interviews
what_it_shows: The integrator reaches the EWS through an always-on remote desktop tool with one shared account and no MFA, approval or recording; no documented usage restrictions

title: Control assessment: role-based training review
source_system: Training records 2025-2026; interviews with 3 Shift Supervisors and both I&E technicians
what_it_shows: No role-based security training for operators, I&E technicians, the Controls Engineer or integrator staff; HR and payroll staff receive privacy training through the HR vendor onboarding

title: Control assessment: audit record review interviews
source_system: DCS event journal; firewall logs; IT Manager and Controls Engineer interviews
what_it_shows: Nobody reviews, analyzes or reports on DCS, SIS or firewall audit records

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration review
source_system: DCS configuration export; 2019 hardening checklist; Controls Engineer interview
what_it_shows: No documented baseline for the DCS, SIS, firewall or OT workstations; nightly exports exist but are not controlled as a baseline

title: Control assessment: change control review
source_system: MOC procedure rev. 2021; MOC log 2025-2026; DCS change history; Process Engineer and Controls Engineer interviews
what_it_shows: Control system, recipe, PLC and firewall changes are made outside MOC, without review, impact analysis or a change log

title: Control assessment: SIS keyswitch and change access inspection
source_system: SIS keyswitch inspection and photo; EWS installed software list; DCS security configuration; badge report for the engineering office
what_it_shows: SIS keyswitch found in the remote program position; SIS engineering software installed on the DCS EWS; engineering office unlocked on night shift; the keyswitch was returned to run and locked the same day

title: Control assessment: least functionality review
source_system: Installed software and services lists for 3 operator stations, the EWS and the historian
what_it_shows: Remote desktop tool, office utilities and SIS engineering software on the EWS; remote desktop protocols not restricted; file sharing enabled between the historian and the business network

title: Control assessment: component inventory test
source_system: DCS project file; walkthrough; 2-hour passive network capture on the supervisory network
what_it_shows: No OT inventory; the capture found 11 devices not in the DCS project file, including the packaging HMIs and 2 unmanaged switches

title: Control assessment: contingency plan review
source_system: IT contingency plan (office only); emergency action plan; P05 BIA; Plant Manager and Controls Engineer interviews
what_it_shows: No contingency plan covers the PCBMS; the IT plan covers office systems only; the 2026 BIA identifies essential functions and recovery objectives

title: Control assessment: contingency test review
source_system: Controls Engineer interview; maintenance records; P05 BIA
what_it_shows: No OT contingency plan test has been run; DCS configuration and recipe backups have never been restored

title: Control assessment: OT backup test
source_system: Backup job log; EWS and USB drive contents; Controls Engineer interview; attempted restore of one recipe file to spare hardware
what_it_shows: Nightly exports run; the USB drive holding the full configuration and recipes is unencrypted and unlabeled in an open drawer; no integrity check; documentation not backed up; no offline or immutable copy

title: Control assessment: OT sign-in test
source_system: DCS user list export 2026-08-12; login test at 3 operator stations and the EWS
what_it_shows: Each HMI signs in with one shared operator account and engineers share one DCS engineering account

title: Control assessment: authenticator tests
source_system: Identity provider password policy; HMI password records; default credential test on the loading rack PLC (rack idle)
what_it_shows: The loading rack PLC accepted the manufacturer default password; HMI shared passwords are short, unchanged since 2019 and written on a card in the control room binder; the identity provider manages VPN authenticators

title: Control assessment: incident handling review
source_system: IT incident plan 2023; draft P08 runbook; emergency action plan; IT Manager and 3 Shift Supervisor interviews
what_it_shows: No OT incident handling capability at the time of testing; the OT runbook was in draft; operators treat anomalies as instrument faults; IT and OT events handled differently

title: Control assessment: notification path test
source_system: Emergency action plan; phone system design; call test from the control room with the business network switch unplugged; 3 Shift Supervisor interviews
what_it_shows: Release reporting contacts are defined; the control room phone had no dial tone with the business network down

title: Control assessment: removable media test
source_system: USB device history on 3 operator stations and the EWS; walkthrough
what_it_shows: USB storage allowed on all HMIs; device history shows 23 distinct USB drives, including 4 from the integrator and vendors; no scanning station

title: Control assessment: external service provider review
source_system: DCS integrator and data science contractor agreements; ERP vendor contract and SOC 2 report; Controller interview
what_it_shows: Integrator and data science contractor agreements contain no security requirements; no documented oversight or monitoring of providers; the ERP vendor SOC 2 report had never been reviewed before this project

title: Control assessment: boundary protection test
source_system: Firewall rule export 2026-07-16; historian network settings; traceroute tests from an office PC
what_it_shows: An office PC reached the historian on its control-side address, bypassing the firewall; no OT DMZ; 'any' rules for the integrator and historian; the rack PLC on the business network; firewall logs errors only

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation review
source_system: Patch records; DCS vendor lifecycle notice; KEV catalog comparison for OT workstation OS versions; Controls Engineer interview
what_it_shows: Vendor-qualified patches are tested before installation and installed only at the annual turnaround; the DCS is two major releases behind; vendor notices go to a former employee's mailbox

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection test
source_system: Endpoint console report; OT workstation software lists; antivirus test file on an office PC and a historian client
what_it_shows: None of the 16 OT workstations has malicious code protection; the test file was not detected on the historian client

title: Control assessment: monitoring review
source_system: Firewall logging settings; network design; IT Manager interview
what_it_shows: No monitoring of the OT network; DCS, SIS and firewall logs are not collected or analyzed
